titre: [$175] Tag picker search re-sorts the entire tag list on every keystroke
corps:
### Problem Searching for an expense tag re-sorts the workspace’s entire tag list on every keystroke, causing noticeable lag with large lists. Reported Chrome development-build measurements at 4× CPU slowdown: - 20,000 randomly ordered tags: 416 ms per key. - 50,000 randomly ordered tags: 832 ms per key. ### Proposed fix Cache sorted tags per tags object so search-only changes filter the existing list without re-sorting. Preserve ordering, selected-tag behavior, disabled-tag filtering, and GL-code search. Draft implementation and before/after videos: https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/107505 ### Verification Verify searching and clearing search with large tag lists, unchanged ordering and selection behavior, and correct updates when workspace tags change. [Slack discussion](https://expensify.slack.com/archives/C01GTK53T8Q/p1795148719776729?thread_ts=1795148277.048579) Reported by @roryabraham via DM with MelvinBot
